_comment: Payload budget for the published npm tarball (road-to-zero-ceremony-install Phase 4). MEASURED, NEVER INVENTED — the numbers below come from `npm pack --dry-run --json --ignore-scripts` on the tracked tree at 9.9.0 (2026-07-31). Two metrics, both genuinely ungated before this file: COMPRESSED tarball size, and PER-SKILL share of the skills subtree. The UNPACKED size is deliberately absent — it is already owned by src/config/evaluator-budgets.json (unpacked_size_mb), and a second number for one lever is how three conflicting figures start circulating.
measurement_conditions: npm pack --dry-run --json --ignore-scripts, run at the repo root on a clean checkout. `--ignore-scripts` means NO build runs, so dist/cli, dist/ui, dist/mcp and dist/hooks are absent and the figure covers only the TRACKED payload (src/scripts/, dist/agent-src/, dist/install/, docs/guidelines/, templates). That is deliberate: this gate is always-on for every PR, and the tracked content tree is exactly the surface that grows by accretion. The built artifact is ~5.4 MB larger and is gated separately, at release time, by evaluator-budgets.unpacked_size_mb.

packed_size_mb.method: npm pack --dry-run --json --ignore-scripts → dist.size / 1e6 (the compressed tarball a consumer actually downloads)

per_skill_share.basis: a single skill's share of the total bytes under dist/agent-src/skills/ in the tarball
per_skill_share.rationale: Measured 2026-07-31: the largest non-excepted skill is corpus-grounding at 2.33%, so a 5% cap is green with better than 2x headroom and red for any skill that doubles. It is a falsifiable gate, not a ritual one.

design-intelligence.reason: 771 KB of BM25 corpus (27 CSVs + 16 design-language prose specs + manifest.json) consumed at runtime by corpus-grounding's retriever, and referenced by 6 further skills. Moving it behind a lazy fetch would add a network dependency to a skill that works offline today — the same trade-off ADR-061 §8 already REJECTED for a 745 KB font index. The exception is visible debt, not an endorsement: raising max_pct requires a reason in the same commit.
